Minat 40 sekand men 1600m | Complete Guide + Practice Plan
Agar aapka lakshy 1600 mitar 4:40 men pura karna hai, to yah vidiyo aapke lie bahut important hai. is vidiyo men aapko bataya gaya hai ki kaise sahi strategy, practice aur technique se aap apni running speed barha sakte hain.
Is vidiyo men aap sikhenge:
1600m run ki sahi strategy
Shuruaat se ant tak pace kaise maintain karen
Breathing technique aur stamina barhane ke tarike
Roz ka practice plan
Army, SSC GD, Police physical ke lie taiyari kaise karen
